WildSpark 2.1.0 adds WildDrops, a focused tooltip-only integration for quest-starting loot.

When you mouse over a creature, its tooltip can show the quest item, recorded percentage drop chance, approximate average kills per drop, and quest title. Rare drops are included by default. The existing quest, race/class, progress, and already-owned-item filters remain in effect.

WildDrops includes the required mob, quest, item, and drop-rate database. It does not include the standalone browser, nameplate markers, reminders, report tools, or minimap button. Its settings are available in WildSpark's WildDrops tab. The module uses WildSpark's own icon artwork.

## Install

Extract `WildSpark-2.1.0.zip` and copy the included `WildSpark` folder into `Interface/AddOns`. Disable standalone copies of integrated modules to avoid duplicate loading.
